FAILURE_A_ROOT_CAUSE.finding: The Shadow semantic recorder was already isolated under structured_adapter_shadow_runtime, but the shared Week2LLMGateway still used its default canonical error_logs/week2_llm_errors.jsonl path. The technical validation rejection therefore created a canonical run-root error artifact.

api_effect.mechanism: build_research_response reports the existence of the canonical Week2 error-log file.

FAILURE_A_FIX.description: Week2LLMGateway now accepts a validated error-log artifact path while retaining the canonical path as its default. Both Phase 1 Shadow gateway builders explicitly select structured_adapter_shadow_runtime/error_logs/week2_llm_errors.jsonl. Canonical live Week2 callers keep their prior default unchanged.

FAILURE_A_OFFLINE_VERIFICATION.invariant: Legacy-only and Legacy-plus-Shadow API responses are equal; canonical week2_llm_error_logs remains false; Shadow diagnostics contain the error.

FAILURE_B_ROOT_CAUSE.why_rejected: The exact quote had two source occurrences and the claim-linked deterministic hint set did not reduce them to one. The resolver returned no span; normalization emitted an invalid placeholder span; the unchanged validator rejected the whole bundle with SHADOW_SOURCE_SPAN_INVALID.
FAILURE_B_ROOT_CAUSE.forensic_limitation: The rejected semantic call record persisted raw_output_text=null, raw_output_sha256=null, validated_output=null, and the sidecar retained only the aggregate resolver record. Consequently the exact Provider claim, quote text, claim-level candidate_ids, occurrence offsets, and contexts cannot be reconstructed from the immutable artifacts. Reporting guessed text or offsets would fabricate evidence.

FAILURE_B_FIX_OR_NO_FIX.product_decision_required: Decide whether to improve duplicate-quote protocol/location binding and rejected-response forensic persistence before authorizing a new Canary.
